scope: Static Git-object source review of physics v17 integration. This receipt records no new test, build, browser or GPU execution.

buildIdentityProvidedByIntegrationOwner.orderingCorrection: The integration owner corrected its initial Python Path-component sort to the full-string lexical ordering used by Vite; the corrected Node recomputation matches the emitted build and all 794 committed input blobs.

offroadWaterAndThermalDependency.finding: Track.evolve now uses fixed 0.5-second coupled water/surface/substrate updates without excluding offroad venues. Track.sample copies grid water and temperature into successful offroad contact samples. DirtBikeVehicle reaches peakGrip through BikeVehicle.surfaceGrip, so changed water-film evolution can change wet motocross traction.
offroadWaterAndThermalDependency.qualification: Both water and temperature channels are shared. The identified direct effect on ordinary MX soil is water-dependent grip; material temperature also enters materialGrip, whose melt response is gated by meltSensitive materials. This review does not claim a calibrated soil thermal model.

unsealedRubber.finding: rubberGrip returns 1 for unsealed materials. Track.sample already zeroes rubber and marbles on unsealed offroad contacts. The new rubber inversion therefore adds no rubber-line effect to ordinary motocross dirt.
unsealedRubber.remainingScope: Sealed rallycross, supermoto and paved contacts can receive the new rubber behavior.

courseWearAndPractice.finding: Jump/berm surveys and the static launch/landing/gap/berm weights remain unchanged. CourseTerrain.weather, soil moisture, O.MOISTURE, dry/damp/wet classification and actual same-station PB interpolation remain unchanged. Real attempt times may change through the shared water physics; the comparator still measures real passage times.
courseWearAndPractice.recordLifetime: Berm practice history is session-local, with its existing course/machine resets and eligibility rules.

recordCompatibility.finding: Persistent records use the new simulation version; prior physics records retain their original identity category.

fourWheelBoundary.finding: Direction-aware drivingSlip ABS/TC changes and supported-contact clutch inertia are applied in Vehicle stepping. DirtBikeVehicle and BikeVehicle retain their overridden bike stepping/drive paths.

runtimeBoundary.presentedForces: RacingRenderer now feeds inertial-camera acceleration and impact from the PresentedFrame values rather than the newer raw snapshot; zero-time samples establish the force baseline.
runtimeBoundary.warmupPreserved: The motorcycle hidden-Formula-host compilation exclusions and existing GPU completion gates are unchanged by this incoming revision.
runtimeBoundary.motocrossChase: Motocross chase remains on its independent motocrossCamera update path.
runtimeBoundary.motorcycleOnboard: BikeShells.onboard supplies the measured motorcycle mount after the generic seated-camera calculation. This change is not evidence of newly verified motocross recoil.
